about: Storage connectivity failures on ESX 9.1.1 hosts, read from logs. One symptom per identifier; where both channels carry an identifier, both are symptoms and the alert joins them with OR. Every condition is CONTAINS on the complete identifier and every trigger is COUNT above a threshold. The alerts inform people and record the timeline; vSphere HA VM Component Protection is the actuator for device loss and all paths down.

validatedMeans.catalog9.1.1: the event type is in the 9.1.1 vCenter event catalog (EventManager.description.eventInfo)
validatedMeans.seen9.1.1: the identifier or record format was read in a 9.1.1 host's records or vCenter's event stream
validatedMeans.family9.1.1: a sibling was read on 9.1.1 and the identifier itself comes from the vendor's knowledge base; proven by a labelled line

alerts.condition: SP-01 Storage device permanently lost, PDL
alerts.detects: permanent device loss: the array reported the device gone on all paths
all paths down began: no path answers and no device-loss code arrived

alerts.condition: SP-03 All paths down timed out, non-VM I/O failing fast
alerts.detects: the all-paths-down timer ran out: non-VM I/O now fails fast, VM I/O keeps retrying

alerts.condition: SP-04 Storage paths dead or flapping
alerts.detects: paths changed state to dead, or a path's state keeps changing

alerts.condition: SP-05 Path redundancy degraded or connectivity lost
alerts.detects: a device runs on fewer paths than configured, or on none

alerts.condition: SP-06 Datastore access lost, VMFS heartbeat or NFS server
alerts.detects: a datastore stopped answering: a VMFS heartbeat timed out or an NFS server disconnected

alerts.condition: SP-07 Frequent power-on resets on a device or path
alerts.detects: frequent power-on reset unit attentions on a device or a path
host-side SCSI command failures: lost connections, timeouts, resets

alerts.condition: SP-C1 Host at risk of hanging, storage lost and commands failing
alerts.detects: storage lost (device loss or timeout) while commands fail with no connection, on one host

alerts.condition: SP-C2 Host lost to vCenter after storage symptoms
alerts.detects: vCenter lost the host while it was reporting all paths down

alerts.condition: SP-C3 Zoning or optics signature, lost connections and failing paths
alerts.detects: lost connections together with dead paths or lost redundancy: a zoning or optics signature
